name: Check your strategy, then turn it into a 90-day plan
why: Turns a checked strategy into a 90-day plan with owners, the same shape as the plan that ends every health check.

name: Prepare a board decision brief
why: An evidence-backed brief for a decision due, a companion to the big decision memo prompt.

name: Fleet replacement cash comparer
why: A cash schedule for replacing or keeping a vehicle, the classic lease-or-buy decision memo.

name: Cash lever ranker
why: Ranks the changes that free the most cash, useful when the health check rates the cash cycle amber or red.

name: Debt maturity funding ladder
why: Rolls cash through upcoming debt maturities to find the biggest gap, extending the debt map.

name: Debt service covenant headroom checker
why: Shows headroom over a debt service covenant in each test period, the covenant step of the debt map and monthly cycle.

name: Refinancing payoff revision assistant
why: Checks a refinancing raises enough to repay the old loan, useful when a new loan offer replaces existing debt.

name: Deal EBITDA addback checker
why: Applies an agreed addback cap to EBITDA, a check alongside the quality of earnings review.

name: Prepare a due diligence document index
why: Builds a versioned document index and request coverage map, the data room step of sale preparation and buy-side diligence.

name: Working capital true-up checker
why: Works out who pays whom when final working capital differs from the peg after a sale.

name: Reconcile seller closing cash
why: Shows what a seller has received, what is held back and what is still owed after completion.
